title: Deal approval
description: For quotes, discounts and contract terms: a written approval matrix, a named approver above each threshold and finance or legal review of non-standard terms.

sources.title: IFRS Foundation, IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

rules.instruction: Keep a dated approval matrix that gives, for each discount level, payment term and clause deviation, the role that can approve it.
rules.verification: Open the approval matrix and check its date and that each threshold names an approving role.

rules.instruction: Record on the quote the named approver and the approval date for every discount above the matrix threshold, before the quote is sent.
rules.verification: Export the quotes of the period and check that each one above the threshold has an approver and an approval date earlier than the sent date.

rules.instruction: Send non-standard terms, such as liability caps, extended payment terms or service credits, to legal or finance as the matrix requires before signature.
rules.verification: For each signed deal with a deviation from the standard terms, check that the deal record links the legal or finance approval.

rules.instruction: Ask finance to review deals with free periods, ramps, bundles or side commitments for their revenue treatment before signature.
rules.verification: Check that each such deal record links a finance review dated before signature.
